authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan surveys. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have 8 hours, i will review once your time is done.

proposals.evidence: Platts explicitly records pī-lenā as an intensive drinking construction. The response contains the bare drink stem pī (CDIAL 8209) followed by take, either imperative le/lo or the liyo-type perfect recorded in CDIAL 10948. The take stem’s analogical history is retained in the primary evidence. Both lexical members receive ordered links; longer unanalysed auxiliaries and ambiguous plain pīla forms are excluded.
